proposed_decision.rule: Recognize final -VAN as a governed place/location formative supported by FROZEN VALIVAN, TAYOVAN and PAROVAN. Its productivity is NONPRODUCTIVE_CLOSED_EVIDENCE: it may analyze attested forms and support already-governed closed KUVAN rationale, but it does not license arbitrary new X+VAN derivations.
proposed_decision.rationale: All three known exact final-VAN forms are FROZEN place/location nouns and no final-VAN counterexample is known; however, only VALI is independently established as a base, so open derivational productivity is not justified.

governance_decisions.proposal: Do not create VAN as a standalone lexical entry under B7.
Do not license arbitrary X+VAN word formation; every new derivation requires its own explicit authorship gate unless a future productivity gate changes this.
AUTH-001 KUVAN remains a CANDIDATE closed specialization; B7 may strengthen its -VAN rationale but does not promote KUVAN, KU or interrogative productivity.
Do not infer VANI=morar/residir from VAN + final I; VANI semantics remain unresolved for B12.
B7 changes no final-I rule, PARAZAMO/PARAZAMI analysis, grammar, productivity outside -VAN analysis, or curriculum slots.

approval_rule: A future SIGA may approve only DEC-B7-001 through DEC-B7-006 if this gate remains materially unchanged. The same SIGA must not approve B8 or create productive X+VAN derivation.
